state.context:
The finish condition is faithful runnable replacement of manolea-2/tests, with Can responsible for setup/actions/expectations, exact fixture assets preserved and documentation current. This is a deletion planning request, not authorization to alter or remove implementation. Legacy scope is Can’s 143-task, 224-file, 292-row self-suite, which has replaced none of the requested Manolea files. The candidate list drops old ledgers, evidence and Python gates, native-can campaigns/controllers/bootstrap, owner/reference and schema code, runtime testing services and exclusive compiler support. Bootstrap/reference reads a committed P04 seed anchor in the plan; both can disappear in a single paired cut. Emission currently injects all test-support imports, requiring simultaneous pruning of state/binding code, catalogue definitions and module metadata plus normal mirror regeneration. Driver staging/cache/worker/lease facilities are dedicated to that legacy route. Preserve ordinary assertion execution, native AI declarations and core owner functionality that production operations use. Existing platform SQL, file/process, fetch and server implementations use native JavaScript/Bun. Remaining test requirements call for narrow child-lifetime handles, filesystem failure/kind facts and Playwright control; the legacy in-memory DB observer cannot stand in for independent real-database evidence.
The subjects are trusted and existing recovery probes use operator-owned roots. Preserve independent external results, deliberate wrong-result/missing-check rejection and complete cleanup, while respecting limited Mac load/storage. A local cooperative profile lacks adversarial hard memory/tmp limits. The old framework mandates strict P13/P14/P23 identities R/N/C/S/A, yet no audited Manolea behavior establishes a need for that entire protocol. Inventory reconciliation, source change detection, behavioral vectors and actual owner lifecycle controls earned their cost; repeated literals and proof narration do not establish equivalent execution. Reliable prior percentage and per-control hour figures are absent. Preserve one example each of receipt, slice and ledger through pinned Git object addresses, without duplicating deleted material. Land coherent checked commits immediately. A bounded automatic elapsed/usage log should enforce explicit ceilings without recreating the previous management stack.

architecture.instructions: Choose how the new suite should execute without making unsupported isolation claims.

criteria.minimal_native: Adopt an explicitly revised trusted cooperative runtime with bounded native JavaScript/Bun mechanics and small needed adapters, keeping all test decisions in Can, independent facts and cleanup, and naming the missing hard hostile-resource guarantee.
criteria.strict_framework: Complete the entire sealed reference/resource-owner model and current strict qualification as a prerequisite, with uncertain environmental delay and additional shared engineering.
criteria.wrapper: Retain the original host scenario/verdict implementation elsewhere and let Can launch it, accepting that the file move leaves the intended semantic migration undone.

removal.instructions: Which removal plan meets the aggressive reset and preserves a coherent executable tree?

criteria.closed_cut: Retire all selected framework layers while editing their dependent imports, metadata and source in the same increments; historical examples are recovered by pinned Git identity with no copy archive.
criteria.rehome_all: Keep all old proof and execution subsystems under renamed locations, maintaining their existing API and prerequisite chains.
criteria.blind_delete: Drop the largest directories without coupling dependent compiler imports or seed-anchor reads, accepting temporarily broken verification and output.

controls.instructions: Select an explicit point at which sufficient behavioral assurance stops further process work.

criteria.minimal_actual: Finish after external facts, one targeted bad-result control, complete required-check identities and cleanup are demonstrated; use a single shared family receipt with source binding.
criteria.ladder: Keep producing row parity proofs, prose receipts, individual reviews and extra validation layers until the old management system is fully accepted.
criteria.skip: Count literal self-consistency plus static acceptance as enough to delete executing tests, omitting real product runs and deliberate failure/release evidence.
